principle_violations.reason: The Order class is managing both the order details and the order status. This increases the complexity and responsibility of the class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the status management from the order details by introducing a new class to handle status-related operations.

principle_violations.reason: Every time a new type of payment processor is added, a new subclass needs to be created, which requires modifying existing parts of the payment processing system.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a PaymentMethodStrategy interface, allowing new payment methods to be added without modifying existing code.
